name: Matta
description: Ask Matta, Regnant's semantic layer, what the business knows about a supplier, customer or employee: governed facts across ERP, CRM and HR, each cited to its source system

credentials.name: MATTA_URL
credentials.label: Matta address
credentials.help: Matta's ontology API (port 8000 in the default deployment), without /api/v1.

credentials.name: MATTA_API_KEY
credentials.label: API key
credentials.help: A read key: one of the hashes in Matta's MATTA_API_KEYS, with role read. Sent as X-API-Key.

actions.label: Get grounded facts
actions.description: The entities that match a question and their facts, each with its source system, plus a prompt block to hand to a model. Matta retrieves; the workflow's own AI step does the judging.

fields.name: question
fields.label: Question
fields.placeholder: What do we know about supplier Kilimanjaro Office Supplies?

actions.label: Ask a grounded question
actions.description: A short answer composed only from Matta's facts, with citations. If Matta's model is Cordon, the answer carries Cordon's signed receipt.
